title: Shared Mirror edit basis + MEND coefficient generator
hypothesis: For multiple key-routed local edit requests whose matrix updates share two atoms, an editor that emits two per-edit coordinates and decodes them over a shared basis will preserve held-out edit RMSE <=0.05, locality RMSE <=0.05, wrong-route rate <=0.01, and use <=0.75x the actual payload bytes of a MEND-style full-update bank; the matched native coefficient/basis implementation tests whether any gain is Mirror-specific.
physical_object: one frozen 8x8 linear base, a shared two-matrix edit basis, and one shared support-signal editor
mirror_coordinate: two generated coefficients per edit request
logical_multiplicity: 20 simultaneously available key-routed edit functions, four held out from editor training
controls: MEND-style network maps flattened support gradient to a full 8x8 update
same two-coefficient editor and basis as direct native low-rank control
rank-one support-derived ROME-style edit per request
independent least-squares 8x8 update from each support set

task.type: synthetic simultaneous local edits selected by a frozen nearest-key router
task.key_anchors: the first 20 coordinate basis vectors in R^24, serialized as float32 in each paid inference payload
task.target_update_family: rank at most two from a seeded shared basis; coefficients and basis are not exposed to the learned editor

development.selection_metric: held-out edit RMSE, locality RMSE, route accuracy, actual payload bytes, and separately timed edit generation/query runtime

paid_objects: all MEND updates or Mirror/native codes

compute.operation_proxy: Learned generator MAC/edit = 36*32 + 32*out_dim + (2*36 for Mirror/native decode); out_dim=36 for MEND and 2 for Mirror/native. Routed query MAC proxy/example = 36 for the base/update matrix multiply plus 20*6 distance operations; router comparisons and exp-like operations are reported separately as counts. Support controls charge their least-squares/rank-one solve proxy and routed query operations separately.

gates.PROMISING: Both development seeds: held-out edit RMSE <=0.05, locality RMSE <=0.05, wrong-route rate <=0.01, Mirror payload <=0.75x MEND and <=1.0x independent-fit payload, and edit-generation MAC/edit <=1.25x MEND. This establishes a native shared-basis storage signal only if the direct native control is separately reported; it is not Mirror-specific when output/payload exactly alias.
gates.FAIL: Independent upper passes the validity bounds but either the quality/storage/route/compute clause fails or direct native low-rank exactly aliases Mirror.
gates.NOT ESTABLISHED: Independent support-fit upper has edit RMSE >0.025 or locality RMSE >0.05, wrong-route rate >0.01 on its own queries, or serialization/metric replay fails.

boundaries: Synthetic linear model editing only; this is not a factual language-model MEND reproduction.
All methods share the same nearest-key router, and the complete key table/radius is charged in every payload.
Locality uses independent random inputs and tests whether any edit is incorrectly routed; simultaneous queries use the closest edit key when within radius.
The independent full-update fit must pass frozen edit, locality and route bounds before quality/storage-frontier conclusions.
Fresh worlds remain sealed unless the complete frozen PROMISING gate passes; an exact native alias disallows a Mirror-specific claim.
